title: Tooltip
description: A label that appears on hover and focus, in ink black. Pure CSS — no positioning library, no JS.
usage: For naming icon buttons and shortening explanations. Never for essential information — if it matters, write it on the page. Keep it under five words.
a11y: Appears on hover and keyboard focus (:focus-visible), so the trigger must be focusable. The tip text is CSS generated content with empty alternative text, so it does not change the trigger's accessible name and is not exposed as a description: an icon-only trigger needs its own aria-label, and essential information belongs on the page. Not implemented (CSS only): dismissing with Escape and keeping the tip open while the pointer moves onto it (WCAG 1.4.13 content on hover or focus).
